title: A notes file
description:
A small notes program that keeps its notes in a text file between runs.

```
> add Buy bread
Saved note 1
> add Call the dentist
Saved note 2
> list
1. Buy bread
2. Call the dentist
> delete 1
Deleted note 1
> list
1. Call the dentist
> quit
```
